title: Morning Rounds — scrubs and clipboard, second pass

steps.path: The red scrub top on the welcome expression
steps.headline: The red now rises into a scrub top with a small cream V-neck, rather than a curved stripe.
steps.changed: Red shoulders reach higher on both sides. A cream V opens below the muzzle; the face and sleeves keep their colours.
steps.notice: Does this look more like the red scrubs worn by the dog in the wallpaper?

steps.path: The board beside its right hand
steps.headline: The clipboard stands nearly upright and tucks into the dog's hand.
steps.changed: The board moved closer to the arm, lost its strong slant, and sits behind a visible tan grip.
steps.notice: Check whether it now looks carried instead of floating beside the hand.

steps.path: The welcome expression at its 80-pixel display size
steps.headline: See the scrub neckline and held board at the size you would normally see them.
steps.changed: The same first and second revisions shown at 80 pixels, with no enlarged mascot art.
steps.notice: Judge the whole dog rather than the enlarged details.
steps.risk: These are stills of the flat art; animation and drag are not shown.
